{{Quote|Fleet Admiral Numinn has authorized the formation of the Coruscant Aegis--an elite attack squadron meant to break the Imperial offensive, swiftly and quietly.|Republic Navy Flight Commander Judin attempts to recruit a Republic hero into the newly formed Coruscant Aegis|<ref name="RFC" />}}
The '''Coruscant Aegis''' was an elite attack [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The unit's initial mission was to undertake [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-based missions to quell illegal Imperial attacks against Republic assets seeking to provoke a breach of the terms of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and reignite hostilities between the two factions. The squadron's missions were conducted across the entirety of the galaxy.

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Aegis first appeared in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]]. All four Republic player character classes gained access to a personal starship after concluding their respective class stories on the Republic capital world of Coruscant. The initial use of the Republic Fleet Command console on the starship's bridge initiated a conversation with a Republic Flight Commander non-player character, identified as Flight Commander Judin in dialogue, which served as a story backdrop for the in-game space missions. Among the dialogue options, players could choose to have their character demand installment as the squadron leader as a condition for joining the unit, to which Judin consented. This content was mirrored for Imperial faction player characters, who enlist in the [[Empire's Fury]].<ref name="RFC" />
